description: This file contains utility methods for managing and operating Akka cluster singleton actors, including starting singleton proxies and singleton actors with various configurations.

classes.name: ClusterUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to facilitate the setup and management of Akka cluster singleton actors and proxies.

methods.name: startSingletonProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy actor that forwards messages to a singleton actor, configured with a specific role.

methods.name: startSingleton
methods.description: Starts a singleton actor within the cluster, providing multiple overloads for different configurations.
